findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: africastalking_fetch_messages, africastalking_get_voice_queue_status · Private data: africastalking_get_balance, africastalking_send_mobile_data, africastalking_get_mobile_data_wallet_balance · Public sink: africastalking_get_balance, africastalking_fetch_messages, africastalking_send_sms, africastalking_send_airtime, africastalking_find_airtime_transaction, africastalking_send_mobile_data, africastalking_find_mobile_data_transaction, africastalking_make_voice_call, africastalking_get_voice_queue_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: africastalking_fetch_messages, africastalking_get_voice_queue_status · Private data: africastalking_get_balance, africastalking_send_mobile_data, africastalking_get_mobile_data_wallet_balance · Public sink: africastalking_get_balance, africastalking_fetch_messages, africastalking_send_sms, africastalking_send_airtime, africastalking_find_airtime_transaction, africastalking_send_mobile_data, africastalking_find_mobile_data_transaction, africastalking_make_voice_call, africastalking_get_voice_queue_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
